packageRules.description: Internal stSoftwareAU/* packages are trusted and may update immediately (issue #17). null clears the top-level minimumReleaseAge for these packages (Renovate treats null and "0 days" alike) and is the only exemption form the semgrep p/default rule renovate-missing-minimum-release-age accepts inside packageRules (issue #159). The github-actions manager needs no explicit rule: the top-level 24-hour minimumReleaseAge already applies to it.

customManagers.description: Quarantine Deno standard library URL imports (e.g. https://deno.land/std@0.208.0/path/mod.ts) — these are picked up from any .ts file by matching the URL pattern (issue #17).

Quarantine CDN-loaded browser libraries (Bootstrap, Chart.js, chart.js-date-fns adapter) referenced from docs/index.html and docs/sw.js. Without this, CDN URLs escape Renovate's built-in managers and avoid the quarantine (issue #17).
